summary: I recommend accept for FP-0001, implementation commit 05d2d42. Evidence commit 4ca37a2 closes both items that blocked review 2. First, raw/sha256sums-check.log records GNU coreutils 8.32 `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` exiting 0 twice: once with 90/90 entries OK against the prior file and once with 95/95 OK against the regenerated one. The digests of the 7 CRLF files are byte-identical in both versions, and the README now retracts the wrong FAILED claim (README:28-29). Second, raw/head-05d2d42-verification.log runs in a detached 05d2d42 worktree. That worktree reports commit 05d2d42 and tree b8bd08d0…, fingerprint f2d2e0e6…/76 and ec150588…/12, and all 9 gate receipts pass evidence-check with current_source true. The same log shows an empty protected-path `--stat` against 89109be, a name-status list of allowed paths only, and two amend diffs that touch nothing outside the evidence directory. The minor findings are resolved as well: the 89109be file count is confirmed at 81, the 6 ignored archive files are preserved and digest-matched, the full manifest recheck is recorded, the probe attribution is extracted from the session transcript, and the README wording is corrected. The controller hardening items moved to FP-0028 with explicit acceptance criteria. None of them can make a failed command or gate report a pass. All 7 criteria are supported by committed raw evidence. One thing remains for the integrator: master has moved past 05d2d42 with changes in source roots (docs/GIT_OPERATIONS.md, engineering/plan.json). So current-source evidence-check fails at the tip, and AGENT_OPERATIONS.md:41 requires the affected gates to be re-run on the integration head.

The second run lists 95 entries, all OK, with exit 0: the earlier 90 plus raw/bootstrap-manifest-recheck.log, raw/bootstrap-preparation-copy.log, raw/head-05d2d42-verification.log, raw/probe-attribution.log and reviews/review-2-reject.json. In the current SHA256SUMS, the 7 CRLF entries are unchanged: 91bb06db…, 43d9f2e8…, b967627e…, a4e24965…, 138f8bba…, cfec5116… and 79db6506…. findings.title: The receipts are bound to 05d2d42, but master has later source-root changes
findings.reasoning: .git/logs/HEAD shows 641920b (docs/GIT_OPERATIONS.md), c1d2ad8, 4370e31 and 97c01b9 (engineering/plan.json), plus the docs and Pages commits, landing after 05d2d42. docs and engineering/plan.json are in policy.json source_roots, so `evidence-check` (current=true) on the gates/ receipts at master tip 97c01b9 will report 'stale source'. This does not affect the acceptance of 05d2d42, which state.json:19 correctly names. However, AGENT_OPERATIONS.md:41 requires re-running the affected gates on the integration head, and GIT_OPERATIONS.md:38 requires check and test to pass at every master commit. I have no record covering either for 641920b..97c01b9.
